"GTA 6 LITE: GAME SCRIPT (UPDATED)

- Intro @COMMENT_BODY@ Branding: \"Five Star Games\" branding on intro and loading screens.
- Localization: 8 countries (Pakistan, USA, India, China, Bangladesh, Turkey, Iran, Saudi Arabia) with strict real-location lock.
- Real-World Sync: Live synchronization of time, date, and weather.
- Camera Angles: Full multi-angle camera support (Cinematic, First-person, Third-person, Drone/Aerial, and Director modes).
- Phones: Lucia uses Realme 5 (rear-sensor) and Jason uses Infinix Smart 9 (side-button).
- Showroom Inventory: Custom Blue-Pink Fade Ferrari, Camouflage Corvette C8, Orange Track Hypercar, Classic Green Lowriders, and civilian Flying Tesla with chasing Police Flying Tesla.
- Building Posters @COMMENT_BODY@ Active Workers: Massive custom game billboards on city buildings, featuring realistic workers actively pasting and painting the posters on scaffolding platforms.
- Hospital: Interactive hospital with patient clothes, IV drips, and medical fees.
- Police @COMMENT_BODY@ Jail: Inmate uniforms, voice-controlled fine payment (\"Pay fine\") or 3-hour wait option.
-Game Title: GTA 6 LITE
Startup @COMMENT_BODY@ Dual-Option Verification Sequence:
​On launch, the game displays \"Five Star Games\" intro branding styled similarly to classic cinematic developer splash screens.
​Startup Verification Screen with Two Options:
​Option 1 (Top Field): Allows the user to enter their Email address along with their Date of Birth (Day, Month, and Year).
​Option 2 (Bottom Black-Themed Field): Designed for users who wish to skip or do not know how to enter an email, allowing them to proceed by entering only their Date of Birth (Day, Month, and Year).
​Age Restriction Rule: If the user is 18 years or older, the game proceeds. If under 18, it displays a bright red warning screen on-screen and strictly blocks gameplay.
Loading Animation @COMMENT_BODY@ Safehouse Spawn:
​Followed by a stylish neon glowing startup and cinematic loading screen sequence.
Country Selection, Dynamic Language Localization @COMMENT_BODY@ Dialogues:
​Post-loading, a country selection menu appears featuring 8 locked regions: Pakistan, USA, India, China, Bangladesh, Turkey, Iran, and Saudi Arabia.
​Dynamic Language @COMMENT_BODY@ Dialogues: Selecting a country automatically configures the game's text, system UI, and all character voice lines/dialogues (from small to major interactions) to that specific local language (Pakistan/India: Urdu/Hindi, USA: English, Turkey: Turkish, China: Chinese, Saudi Arabia: Arabic, Iran: Persian, Bangladesh: Bengali). NPCs walking on roads converse in these localized languages, interact, and dynamically react/talk to or scold the player in the chosen language.
​Upon selecting the country, the player automatically spawns inside that specific country's designated Safehouse.
Core Mechanics, Driving, HUD Layout @COMMENT_BODY@ Real-World Synchronization:
​Open-world environment featuring a realistic mix of paved main roads, paved alleys, unpaved dirt roads, and unpaved dirt alleys across selected countries.
​Real-World Live Synchronization: The game's time, date, and weather conditions (such as live rain, storms, night, morning, and evening) automatically sync and reflect real-life conditions in real time.
​Screen HUD Layout (UI Design):
​Top Left HUD: Displays the active character's Health Bar indicator.
​Top Right HUD: Displays real-time Vehicle Speedometer (Car/Bike Speed) when driving.
​Bottom Left HUD: Displays the 4-directional Mini-map layout with pink GPS route navigation.
​Bottom Right HUD: Displays dynamic Lucia @COMMENT_BODY@ Jason avatar photo icons for quick character switching.
​World @COMMENT_BODY@ Safehouse Lighting Control: At exactly 6:00 PM in the evening, all public and commercial lights across the game map (shops, petrol pumps, railway stations, streets) automatically turn ON, and they automatically turn OFF at exactly 7:00 AM in the morning. In contrast, the characters' (Lucia and Jason) Safehouse lights and appliances are entirely manually controlled by the player using an in-house switch panel featuring 3 interactive butto

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game based on the user’s “GTA 6 LITE” game script, or adapt an existing game.

## Requirements
- Include Five Star Games branding, 18+ DOB verification with email and email-skip options, and an under-18 block screen.
- Support eight region-locked countries with localized UI/dialogue and a regional safehouse; synchronize local date/time and live weather.
- Provide movement, driving, multiple camera modes, character switching, phone interactions, minimap/GPS, service locations, showroom vehicles, and manually controlled safehouse lighting.
- Include hospital treatment, police fine payment by “Pay fine” voice command or a three-hour wait, and city billboards with workers.

## Decisions
- No game scaffold existed, so the assistant created a self-contained browser game in `index.html`.
- Used real-world city coordinates with Open-Meteo weather fetching and browser-local time; email is explicitly optional and not transmitted or stored.
- Created a simplified 2D canvas city-game prototype rather than a full 3D game.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with startup branding, age verification, country selection, regional safehouse, HUD/minimap, keyboard/touch controls, characters, vehicles, camera modes, and interaction menus.
- Added safehouse switches, hospital treatment, police citation menu with voice recognition where supported, phone menus, billboards/workers, and basic NPCs/traffic.
- JavaScript syntax check passed using `node --check /tmp/game.js`.
- Captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/gta-lite.jpg`; Chromium generated the screenshot.

### Active
- Validate the full flow in a browser and fix any runtime or gameplay defects.

### Blocked
